svg.text: Three visual directions for Tessera (same scene)
Panes are glazed tiles on dark grout; colour lives in clips and notes; one
Paper-first: warm white, ink hairlines, notes as black bars with coloured
track ticks; a single vermilion accent. Calm and print-like, but tracks lose
colour and dark mode feels like an afterthought.
Hardware screen: true black, mono type everywhere, glowing amber and green.
Strong identity and very 'Eurorack', but tiring for long editing, poor in
light mode, and close to many tracker plugins.
